remarks: SO MUCH POTENTIAL! This open concept one bedroom condo in the Cove is eagerly awaiting your personal touches. Perfect for those who love the outdoors, you're a short walk from Cove Island Park (the crown jewel of the Stamford Parks) and Cove Island Wildlife Sanctuary, the best kept secret in Stamford. Just a two-minute drive to Cummings Park's tennis and pickleball courts AND recreational softball fields. Are you a cyclist? This building has indoor bicycle storage and is located DIRECTLY on the East Coast Greenway, which runs all the way from Florida to Maine. Like gardening? The current owner has grown everything from basil to zucchini on the squirrel-proof balcony that's a perfect place for your pet to enjoy a sunny day. Don't miss this opportunity to live in a great building in a super neighborhood just minutes from the train, highway and downtown.
